message:
fix(deploy, maint r1): a swap that fails says which half happened; the restart line names code, modules and env

The publish step's two renames can fail between them. The exit stays 4 and nothing is undone, but the
message now says which state it left, read-only from which .tmp is still there: manifest-only (the
published pair does not match -- restore the backup pair by hand), neither (the previous pair should
still be published -- check against the backup's SHA256SUMS), or unknown. A "swap-state" line makes
it machine-readable. The no-restart log names the rule: a restart is needed when server.js, a module
it requires, or its env changes.

Test: gnlink_deploy_test case 13 -- an mv shim on the PATH refuses one rename: 13a sig rename fails
(exit 4, manifest-only, the new manifest is published and the sig is only a .tmp), 13b manifest rename
fails (exit 4, neither, nothing published), 13c a normal publish has no swap-state and the new restart
line. Against the previous script the four wording checks fail and the factual ones pass (behaviour
unchanged). FIXTURE_BASE is overridable (GNLINK_TEST_FIXTURE_BASE) so a current fixture can be used:
the 0.2.109-r2 and 0.2.123 fixtures are refused by the payload gate (GNLinkClipHelper) on main as well.

CLAUDE.md: the release section's old line numbers and the two follow-ups -- already fixed by 65fcee7
(09-23) -- are brought to the script as it is.

Product: deploy script wording only. Test: deploy test case 13 + fixture base. Docs: CLAUDE.md.
